spec.description:
Foilboard Flexifast Fasteners are specialized one-piece nylon
anchor fasteners engineered to secure Foilboard rigid insulation panels directly
to masonry, brickwork, concrete tilt-up slabs, and timber substrates. Featuring
a large, flexible clamping head integrated with an expanding ribbed shank,
Flexifast anchors eliminate thermal bridging while firmly holding panels without
tearing through the aluminum foil facing. They provide an efficient, hammer-in
or push-in fixing solution for residential basement walls, commercial carpark
soffits, and precast facades.
features:
One-piece non-conductive nylon
construction eliminates thermal bridging

Broad flexible head clamps panels
firmly without puncturing the aluminum facing

Expanding barbed anchor shank
locks tightly into pre-drilled masonry or concrete

Durable, UV-stabilized,
and non-corrosive in damp environments

Fast push-in or hammer-in installation
into 8mm pre-drilled holes

Available in multiple lengths (45mm, 70mm, 95mm)
to suit 10mm to 50mm panels

High pull-out resistance to withstand wind
suction and panel weight

Ideal for precast concrete, brick, blockwork, and
timber

install:
Position Foilboard panel flat against masonry,
concrete, or timber substrate

Drill an 8mm hole through the Foilboard panel
into the masonry substrate to minimum 35mm depth

Insert the Flexifast
fastener through the panel into the drilled hole

Tap gently with a hammer or
press firmly until the broad head seats flush against the foil

Ensure anchor
head clamps the panel firmly without over-driving into the EPS core

Space
fasteners at 600mm centers around the perimeter and across the board face

Tape over fastener heads with Foilboard 72mm reinforced foil tape if an
airtight vapor seal is required
selection_checklist:
Measure Foilboard
board thickness to select correct anchor length (45mm, 70mm, or 95mm)

Confirm
masonry drill bit size is 8mm

Calculate quantity needed based on approx. 6-8
fasteners per 2440x1200mm board

Verify substrate is concrete, brick,
blockwork, or dense timber
limitations: Requires pre-drilling into concrete and masonry

Not
designed for hollow plasterboard or soft substrates without structural backing
Non-structural; cannot support secondary heavy cladding hung from the fastener

problem_keywords:
metal screws conducting cold through
insulation
use_cases:
Direct-fixing Foilboard panels to precast concrete basement
walls and car park soffits

Securing rigid insulation to masonry blockwork in
cavity wall construction

Thermal break insulation installation over concrete
tilt-up industrial panels
not_for: Suspended floor joist cradling (use Floor Saddles)
